codeReview.summary: Clean, minimal implementation that replaces Box::leak font storage with FontArc. The change is a drop-in replacement of FontRef<'static> with FontArc in the FontSystem fonts HashMap, leveraging FontArc's Arc-based owned storage to eliminate memory leaks. All downstream consumers (rasterization.rs, measurement.rs) use the Font trait which both types implement, so no changes were needed outside the two modified files.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The architecture.md documents the UI font atlas pattern but does not mention FontArc as the font storage type. Workers implementing future font-related features (e.g., dynamic font reloading, font fallback chains) should know that fonts are stored as FontArc (Arc<dyn Font + Send + Sync>) in the HashMap, not FontRef or raw byte vectors.

The SKILL.md for ui-worker still references Box::leak in the 'Font loading fix' section: 'The 'static lifetime requirement comes from FontRef<'static>'. This is now outdated since FontArc is used. Future workers reading this skill file may be misled about the current approach.

summary: The ui-font-no-leak feature (VAL-UI-002) is correctly implemented. All Box::leak calls in katla_ui/src/text/ have been eliminated and replaced with FontArc::try_from_vec, which owns font data via Arc. The change touches only 2 files (font_loading.rs and mod.rs), removes 10 net lines, and all downstream code works unchanged because FontArc implements the same Font trait. Verification commands (cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy, cargo check) all passed. The worker followed the ui-worker skill procedure and no deviations were noted. Two minor shared state observations were recorded: the architecture.md should document the FontArc storage type, and the ui-worker SKILL.md has stale Box::leak references.
